meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 它把 git 请求分成提交、改写分支历史、查历史、看状态四类，只执行你明确要求的操作。提交会按行为拆成原子提交；回答历史问题时给出提交哈希、文件路径和命令行证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码、改写分支历史，或调查某处改动是谁、何时引入时接管；普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把这些改动按行为拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 会先看 diff 和近期提交的信息风格再分组

say.text: 查一下这行代码是哪次提交改的
say.note: 用 blame 并给出提交哈希和行号

say.text: 帮我用 fixup 把这个补丁合进上一条提交
say.note: 先确认是否已推送，再改写历史

howto.what_en: It classifies git requests into commit, history-rewrite, history-lookup, and status modes, acting only when you explicitly ask. Commits are split into atomic groups; history answers cite commit hashes, file paths, and diff context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit, a branch-history rewrite, or an investigation into when or who changed something; ordinary code edits are skipped.

say_en.text: Split these changes into atomic commits by behavior
say_en.note: reads the diff and recent message style first

say_en.text: Which commit changed this line of code?
say_en.note: uses blame and cites hash and line

say_en.text: Fold this fixup into the previous commit
say_en.note: checks if it's pushed before rewriting
